why: 15 Accounts: a later Apply puts back, in the live model as well as in its snapshot, what the earlier Apply wrote and nobody changed since, so a value this Apply does not write again (a Meta or LSA lead cost after Clear all actuals, a platform below the minimum) does not stay in force. The load-time strip keeps only the lead costs the Apply in force wrote.
old: const was = S.settings.applied; if (was && was.prev && was.patch) { if (isN(was.patch.cpc) && SLM.A.cpc === was.patch.cpc) prev.cpc = was.prev.cpc; Object.entries(was.patch.lines || {}).forEach(([l, v]) => { const p0 = (was.prev.lines || {})[l] || {}, cur = prev.lines[l]; if (cur) Object.keys(v).forEach(k => { if (cur[k] === v[k]) { if (k in p0) cur[k] = p0[k]; else delete cur[k]; } }); }); }
new: const was = S.settings.applied; if (was && was.prev && was.patch) { /* what the earlier Apply wrote, and nobody changed since, goes back to the assumption in the model as well as in the snapshot, so a value this Apply does not write again does not stay in force */ if (isN(was.patch.cpc) && SLM.A.cpc === was.patch.cpc) { prev.cpc = was.prev.cpc; SLM.A.cpc = was.prev.cpc; } Object.entries(was.patch.lines || {}).forEach(([l, v]) => { const p0 = (was.prev.lines || {})[l] || {}, cur = prev.lines[l], live = SLM.A.lines[l]; if (cur) Object.keys(v).forEach(k => { if (cur[k] === v[k]) { if (k in p0) { cur[k] = p0[k]; if (live) live[k] = p0[k]; } else { delete cur[k]; if (live) delete live[k]; } } }); }); }

why: 15 Accounts: a later Apply puts back, in the live model as well as in its snapshot, what the earlier Apply wrote and nobody changed since, so a value this Apply does not write again (a Meta or LSA lead cost after Clear all actuals, a platform below the minimum) does not stay in force. The load-time strip keeps only the lead costs the Apply in force wrote.
old: /* the observed Meta and LSA lead costs stand only while an Apply does: drop any that a revert in an earlier version left in the model */ if (!S.settings || !S.settings.applied) { let n = 0; Object.values(SLM.A.lines).forEach(L => ['metaCpl', 'lsaCpl'].forEach(k => { if (k in L) { delete L[k]; n++; } })); if (n) SLM.set({}); }
new: /* the observed Meta and LSA lead costs stand only while the Apply that wrote them does: drop any that a revert, or a later Apply, in an earlier version left in the model */ { const ap = S.settings && S.settings.applied, pl = (ap && ap.patch && ap.patch.lines) || {}; let n = 0; Object.entries(SLM.A.lines).forEach(([l, L]) => ['metaCpl', 'lsaCpl'].forEach(k => { if (k in L && !(pl[l] && pl[l][k] === L[k])) { delete L[k]; n++; } })); if (n) SLM.set({}); }
